title: Grateful Dead Live at Starlight Theater on 1982-08-03
lineage: TDK-MA > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > R8Brain SRC > Wavelab (adding 16-bit patches) > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F.
source: AUD: FOB, Sennheiser 441's > Sony TC-D5 > MAC > (likely) 1st Gen, from the Brian Schley tape collection;

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of an ’82 show with a stunning “He’s Gone” and a brilliant “Stella Blue”, though the band sounds a bit tired at times.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its clear, crisp sound and captures the ethereal staccato space that leads into a beautiful “He’s Gone”. While most fans celebrate the night as one of the summer gems, several note Jerry’s sore throat and a generally fatigued vibe, with “Stella Blue” standing out as the emotional high point. Overall the tape sounds great, but the performance is mixed.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating of 4.0 across four reviews; recording quality consistently praised while show performance receives both high and low comments, leading to a balanced overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe the sound as great, crisp and clear with no reported drop‑outs or muddiness; the tape captures the spacey ambience well.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Generally praised as a gem of the summer, though some feel the band was fatigued and vocally rough; the ballad “Stella Blue” provides an emotional lift.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Rough, sore‑throat vocals and occasional lyric flubs, but his delivery on “Stella Blue” is praised for its heartfelt fragility; guitar tone noted as beautiful in “He’s Gone”.
band_member_comments.Bob: Flubbed lyrics alongside Jerry; overall contribution described as shaky.
